name: Plant Science
summary: Research-oriented plant-science foundation aligned with Bonn's multidisciplinary programme.
details: The University of Bonn's MSc Plant Sciences integrates fundamental and applied plant science across plant biochemistry, physiology and molecular biology; plant cell biology and development; and plant biodiversity, evolution and systematics. The programme also emphasises hands-on laboratory training and research-driven projects. This portfolio uses Plant Science as the umbrella category for the user's crop-science, plant-biology and sustainable-agriculture research background.
